text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp has begun. 
The Ibis Summer Dash is just around the 
corner, so we must get in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has begun. A most 
rewarding camp where I can continuously 
observe my research subject's changes 24 
hours a day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Tachyon, I have some advice for you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Drop the 24-hour surveillance. Pulling 
all-nighters is bad for your health.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If it's just for a few hours, the Trainer 
and I can cover for you. So get some 
proper sleep, understand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry. The changes are 
obvious at a glance. I'm sure someone will 
come report it soon enough.
choice_data_list:
Wait. What do you mean, an 'obvious 
change'!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll just have to try it and see... 
Heheheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I strictly warned Calstone Light O not to 
eat anything given to her by Agnes Tachyon 
right away.
